assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Production sprite revision for the existing grimdark cyberpunk roguelike Project RL. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and fixes character identity, equipment design, silhouette and pose. Input image 2 is ONLY the accepted hand-painted material/finish reference, NOT a character or pose to copy. Repaint the target with the reference's matte, worn, restrained hand-painted game finish: believable volumes and clothing folds, muted material colors, uneven controlled dark contours, locally abraded fabric/metal and broad readable shadows. Avoid glossy plastic, white cartoon highlights, uniformly thick black outlines and sterile vector/cel shading. Remain readable after reduction to a 60-game-pixel-tall body in a 64px cell. Entire figure, all equipment and all limbs complete; isolated on TRUE TRANSPARENT background, with generous clear margins. No ground, floor, scene, text, frame, cast shadow or glow. Same game's slightly elevated frontal sprite view (not isometric, not a flat top view of a standing person). Neutral diffuse overhead lighting, no colored external lighting. Preserve original material color identities. Do NOT copy the corpse's blood, wounds, death pose or face. This is a living, fully clothed masked adult. EDIT ONLY the Bastion character: orange-red sealed full helmet, dirty ivory short-sleeve undershirt with dark straps/vest details, worn olive combat trousers, dark brown boots and grey gloves. Keep the full helmet, no visible face. Preserve roughly the same head-to-foot proportions and slightly spread bent lower arms, both fists EMPTY for separate weapon layers. No gun, knife or new accessory. Render a complete standing base body ready for independent hand/weapon attachment; enough material definition to match the accepted civilian finish without excessive microdetail.
